review.decision: Approve the regression design before changing tests
review.notes: Exercise the real batch and local preview with private HOME, Codex history and a log-only tmux sender. Preserve both source and destination evidence. The prior RRB-R6 design continues to require actual private-pane hold assertions; diagnose launch and capture separately on Linux.

cases.description: Renamed pane recovery rechecks the historical source
cases.setup: Two saved targets match historical locators by directory and position, with distinct recoverable conversations.
cases.action: During the first dispatch change the second historical record, or leave it stable; drive the real second-pass queue.
cases.expected: The unchanged source is sent exactly once to its target. A replaced source prevents every literal and Enter for that target.

cases.description: An uncertain compatibility write occupies its conversation in the batch
cases.setup: Two restored shell targets select the same recoverable wrapper record. Every tmux invocation uses the private log-only executable.
cases.action: Return an error on the first Enter after recording its literal, then let the batch consider the other pane. Compare with an independent conversation.
cases.expected: The first receipt retains uncertainty. The duplicate gets neither a literal nor Enter; a distinct identity still dispatches.

cases.description: Local preview streams valid saves beyond the remote size cap
cases.setup: Create a valid local save just above 8 MiB with bounded lines, a malformed oversized line, and an empty save.
cases.action: Build and render local plans, verify the complete save fingerprint responds to a tail change and invoke the remote bounded reader.
cases.expected: The valid local pane stays visible and the changed file invalidates its fingerprint. A local read error is distinguishable from an empty save. The remote reader retains its cap.

cases.description: The private Codex-shaped hold fixture remains a named terminal reader
cases.setup: Create a private tmux socket and launch a test-owned terminal reader under the Codex name, independent of whether the host cat executable dispatches by basename.
cases.action: Drive the existing real-pane hold suite through creation, exact menu capture, radar classification, hold and ordinary send controls; diagnose tmux errors separately from an empty screen.
cases.expected: Every original hold and send assertion remains. The fake process is resident before observation. A launch or capture error reports its own failure within the existing wait.
